note: Files: iterate-runs abaybektursun-1115-{000503-1e5f,000525-ea4e,014823-ef56,014833-1daa}/answers.jsonl (modal volume get into runs/theory-tests/<job>/answers.jsonl; 328 rows each, fields text, gold, cap_hit, finish_reason, score_v3, extracted_v3). First row per problem_index per file; finished = cap_hit not true and finish_reason != 'length'; wrong = score_v3 != 1. Candidate C and cleaning follow the recipe literally, in the order given: strip, delete '$' and '*', remove one leading '\[' / '\(' and one trailing '\]' / '\)', strip one trailing '.', then take the brace-balanced content of the last '\boxed{' (when the braces never balance, everything after '\boxed{' is taken). There is no second whitespace strip after the deletions. Main number calls rln4_lib.agree(C, gold) as written, which makes math_verify parse C as the gold side (n13_score.grade(a, b) wraps its first argument as gold). alt_measured uses the other argument order, agree(gold, C), which is how the grader itself compares. The bootstrap resamples problems, each carrying the tuple of its finished wrong rows across the 4 files. n = pooled finished wrong rows. refuted_by_met = measured < 0.025 or fewer than 40 finished wrong rows.

Files: the 4 hard328 Think-SFT files of p1, plus the MATH-500 Think-SFT files abaybektursun-1115-{000512-ee03,014843-85d9,000607-0e92,000621-1d7e}/answers.jsonl (500 rows each); base rows studies/rlneurons/results/day1_3/hard328_base_cue_s4r2-01/rows.jsonl and math500_base_cue-01/rows.jsonl. Base k = number of samples s in 0..3 whose first row with attempt == 0 and sample == s has score_v3 == 1 and cap_hit not true (a missing row counts as not right). Easy = k == 4; Hard = k <= 1. The problem set comes from the problem_index values in the base file, so problems with no base rows drop out. Layout rows are defined as in p1 with agree(C, gold); alt_measured uses agree(gold, C). The rates are pooled over rows (layout rows / finished rows per stratum). The bootstrap resamples (set, problem) entries, each holding that problem's finished rows across its 4 files. n = the smaller stratum's finished-row count. refuted_by_met also fires when either stratum has fewer than 150 finished rows. Possible issue: restarts (attempt > 0) in the base files are ignored, as the recipe says, so a sample that was right only after a restart counts as not right.

Files: the 8 Think-SFT files of p2. Layout rows as in p1 (non-empty C and agree(C, gold)). Blank test on the stored extracted_v3 (null or missing counts as blank), applied in the order listed: delete all whitespace, then the characters $ * : . , then the substrings \[ \] \( \) \boxed{} {}. Because whitespace goes first, '\boxed{ }' becomes '\boxed{}' and is removed. Fewer than 10 layout rows -> refuted_without_number, as the recipe says. alt_measured = the same share among layout rows defined with agree(gold, C). The bootstrap resamples (set, problem) entries that hold at least one layout row (problems with none add nothing to either count). n = number of layout rows. Caveat: extracted_v3 can never be blank in v3's own marker mode (extract_v3 drops empty marker lines), so a blank here means v3 returned mode 'none' (None), or a box or marker whose content is markup only.

File: studies/rlneurons/results/transplant/hard328-01/rows.jsonl (in git). H = arm 'sft1_rl20' (2 rows per problem), T = arm 'think' (4 rows per problem). Finished = cap_hit not true; these rows have no finish_reason field, so the recipe's cap_hit-only definition is the only one available. Blank test as in p3, in the listed order (whitespace, then characters, then substrings). alt_measured runs the substring deletions before and after the character deletions; it differs only for odd strings. All rows of each arm are used, with no deduplication. The bootstrap resamples problems, each carrying its finished H and T rows. n = the smaller pooled finished-row count of the two arms. refuted_by_met = measured > +0.002. Caveat: if almost no rows are blank in either arm, the difference sits near 0 and the interval is narrow; a value of exactly 0 does not meet refuted_by.
